text_block_list.text: We decided to conduct today's training session with Agnes Tachyon in her racing uniform.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I'm not particularly picky about clothes, but I do quite like this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Neither the fabric nor the design has anything particularly special beyond protecting the body. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Neat-Racewear Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's a pretty bold design for your racing racewear~!

text_block_list.name: Flashy-Racewear Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that one look pretty subdued?
But it suits you, not bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Neat-Racewear Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'm glad I went with this design.
...Racing silks really are special after all.

text_block_list.name: Flashy-Racewear Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Wearing this gets me fired up, or maybe
I should say... it makes me want to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Did you hear what was just said?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Every Umamusume has her own unique dedication to her racewear,
and I believe a certain possibility lies hidden within that, but..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. Do you know what that is?
choice_data_list: The power of feelings, or something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, you figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Feelings... the power of belief, they call it.
There is nothing unscientific about that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Put simply,
it's close to things like mindset or motivation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Become number one, run in the lead, lose to no one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It makes me think that every racing outfit
has a unique wish deeply woven into it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the power of feelings is merely a hypothesis,
and hasn't been proven scientifically.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, the Umamusume believe in that power
and pour their wishes into their Racewear, don't they?"
choice_data_list: Do you have a wish too, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Let's see. Whether you believe in it or not,
there's real sentiment poured into it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, why don't you try and guess?
Beyond the limits... Agnes Tachyon continues to pursue the boundless potential of Umamusume.

What she poured into her racing outfit.
That was—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, have you made up your mind?
choice_data_list: A resolve to continue your research?
A resolve to keep chasing possibilities?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed.
You could say this is an expression of my personal conviction.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens from here on, I will continue my research
and keep searching for possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"So that I myself will one day become
the ultimate culmination of bodily modification!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Very well!
Then let us proceed with the experiment at once!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What this racing attire brings to me—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let us see whether my convictions will translate into concrete numbers!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Aiming for further progress in body modification... I shall run forward with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, we start with the turf!
Measure it accurately, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
I'm glad to see you understand so thoroughly!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Running—for me, it is an experiment,
and the very process by which I reach new possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course, my running alone won't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just as each person's thoughts and wishes differ,
what they gain will likely be different as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Those differences might perhaps
be trivial things."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However! You must never overlook this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"In experimentation, the slightest variance is potential itself!
For it can yield massive results!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, if you understand,
then prepare to take notes at once!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The run of an Umamusume clad in her very own outfit...
a Racewear infused with her own resolve!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why don't I take a good, close look at you, then!
